setting-heat_strength-desc: How much warmth one lit torch contributes, on the game's own heat scale: burning firepit 10, embers 6, smouldering firepit 0.25. Default is 1.5. The game applies its usual distance falloff on top, the same way it does for firepits. Set to 0 to disable torch heat.
setting-max_distance-desc: Torches further away than this many blocks contribute nothing (default: 5). Mostly matters indoors: the game scans your whole room for heat sources when you are enclosed, but only 3 blocks around you outdoors.
